youtube_title: Street Dog Scratch: Ignore It or Wash 15 Minutes? Brave vs Normal #14 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL - WHO'S RIGHT? #14. A street dog leaves a tiny scratch. Brave ignores it. Normal washes it with soap and water for 15 minutes and heads to the hospital. Who's right? Comment B or N.
Answer: NORMAL. WHO: wash and flush the wound with soap and water for at least 15 minutes and get post-exposure vaccination right away - even minor scratches count. Once rabies symptoms appear it is almost always fatal; the vaccine on time prevents it. Never put spit, chilli or anything else on it.
Source: WHO rabies fact sheet.
